# Troll trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyFrostTroll | Source: Troll | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Troll trophy is a common drop, 50%, from Trolls in the Black Forest.

### Crafting

• Mossy fishing bait
• Trollstav

### Misc

• Can be displayed on an Item stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

## Trivia

• In the alpha, the Black Forest had a different Troll variant, which was brown-colored. Their trophy can still be spawned in using the developer console with the ID TrophyForestTroll, but has no mesh when dropped on the ground.

Categorias: Trophies
